versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the feishu-bitable-query skill: enables server-side querying of Feishu Bitable records with advanced options.
- Provides efficient filters, sorting, and field selection for large data sets, supporting TSV and JSONL output.
- Offers both formula and structured JSON filtering, with guidance on when to use each mode.
- Supports local time-based filtering and advanced field formatting for cleaner output.
- Designed for scenarios where built-in bitable record listing tools are insufficient (complex filtering, full pagination).
- Automatically handles authentication and output piping patterns for integration with other scripts.
